# One template per block: `=== <name> <bas|cls>`, then the module text. `{k}` is replaced by each word of words.txt.
=== assign bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}
End Sub
=== arg bas
Sub Probe()
    f {k}, 1
End Sub
=== inexpr bas
Sub Probe()
    x = 1 + {k} * 2
End Sub
=== constdecl bas
Const c = {k}
=== caseitem bas
Sub Probe()
    Select Case x
    Case {k}
    End Select
End Sub
